Page 51
May 24 th Cervase Schulty - 38 - ulcered ankle - had 7 blood clots in lungs a year ago - Drs wonder that he still lives ... .
Theresa Troy - 45 at Gr. Rapids stroke three weeks ago Mrs. Marg. Quigley - 56 - Hemoraging
Mrs. Stilwell - in Prov. Hosp.
Angela Mccarthy - 40 - cerebral Hemorg.
Mrs. Victoria Pawlaczyk - brain trouble - "don't seem to care to get well" "Have already lost my faith". . .
1938, June
June Ist Mrs. Stella Blake - 42 - inward canc'r (rectum) Operation last Decem- ber, fears a more serious one now
Mrs. Jessie Wingle - 48 - Very peculiar heart, liver and lung trouble The diaphram torn ..... goes to holy Comm'ion
Catherine Haunan - 62 - arthritis - helpless ...
Salvatore Valente - 26 - nerveous break. - Extremely nerveous 12 yrs ... away from confession 5-6 yrs.
Page 52
Mrs. Hamlin - 31 - operation four years ago has left her very poorly - Baptized as a Presbiterian and later on as a methodist - finally married a Catholic 11 yrs. ago and baptized conditionally. Asks for prayer to bring up her little daughter and be grateful.
Winifred Goodwillie - 40 - of Chicago - Gall and Kidney Trouble - and lately T.B. also.
Philip DeSchmyver ..
Joseph Fr. Bacharach - Jew about 40 - going blind - has wife and 2 small children Catholic.
